exposure: pre-pregnancy BMI categories (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese)
cohort: 3531 single pregnant women who received prenatal examinations and gave birth at the First Affiliated Hospital of Jinan University, China, between December 2018 and June 2020.
finding: Pre-pregnancy overweight and obesity, as well as inadequate or excessive GWG, were associated with increased risks of adverse perinatal outcomes, while maintaining pre-pregnancy BMI and GWG within recommended ranges was associated with reduced risks.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more likely in mothers with inadequate GWG
